item.title: Google Patches Actively Exploited Chrome Zero-Day
item.description: Google on Tuesday shipped security updates for its Chrome web browser to address a zero-day flaw that it said has been exploited in the wild.
item.author: info@thehackernews.com (Sample Author)

item.title: Malicious Browser Extensions With 2 Million Installs Steal Session Cookies
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers have discovered a set of malicious browser extensions with a combined 2 million installs that steal session cookies from logged-in websites.
item.author: info@thehackernews.com (Sample Author)

item.title: Android Banking Trojan Reportedly Poses as Bank Apps in Brazil
item.description: A new Android banking trojan is reportedly being spread in Brazil through fake versions of popular bank apps. Users should only install banking apps from Google Play and check the developer name before installing.
item.author: info@thehackernews.com (Sample Author)

item.title: 13 Malicious NuGet Packages Target .NET Developers With Fake Job Assessments
item.description: Researchers have found 13 malicious NuGet packages aimed at Windows .NET developers. Developers should review their dependencies.
item.author: info@thehackernews.com (Sample Author)
